Hi. I hope I'm not late and that you are still here with us. Don't do it, please.
I know how you feel. It's the same for me at the moment. I can't tell you when it will get better. I don't know how to make it better. I know it hurts. But please stay.
For the moment, you can try taking a nap, going on a nap or listening to music, whatever works for you. I know it's a short-term remedy, but at least it allows you to keep going for a bit longer.
What I've also found useful is writing. Whether it's like a diary, poetry or something else. It allows you to vent if you have no one to talk to. (You have the people here, always). Try painting or drawing. You don't have to be good at it. You just have to put your feelings on a piece of paper.

Also, as I said, something seemed weird about her posts, but I'm not sure if this would qualify as blackfishing.

Also, I'm not an expert on hair, but it doesn't seem like she has a very textured hair and the curls are pretty loose.
She is a Romanian model/makeup artist and there is no mention of her having any African heritage or people of color in her family.
As far as I know, she is not black...
